name: Gmail digest
description: Read the mails matching a Gmail search and summarise them in a few bullet points (who wrote, what they want, dates and amounts). Uses gmail-read-mails, then a fast model.

steps.prompt: Summarise these e-mails for the user in 3 to 6 short bullet points: who wrote, what they want or say, and any dates, deadlines or amounts. Plain text.
